content.text: Explore the lesser-known paradise of India's North East with Kajaawa’s unique 8-day Assam Meghalaya Arunachal Tour. Exploration and travel enthusiasts will like Assam, Meghalaya, and Arunachal Pradesh. The music of the enchanting Noh KaLikai Fall may be heard here, generating waves in the lush valley of Meghalaya. Witness the amazing Monastery of Arunachal Pradesh and a visit to the very famous Kaziranga National Park. Indeed, the North East is a treasure trove of natural and man-made beauties that you can only see and feel during your 9-day trip. This is a realm of incredible beauty where you may experience purely natural beauty and inner tranquilly. So, join Kajaawa in exploring this enchanted area; we guarantee it will be a once-in-a-lifetime adventure.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Visit the magnificent man-made Umiam Lake
Visit Cherrapunji to see the beautiful waterfalls and caverns
Visit Elephant Falls and the breathtaking Shillong Peak on your way to Cherrapunji
Shillong attractions include Ward's Lake, Lady Hydari Park, and the Shillong Golf Course
Take a trip to Kaziranga, which is home to the One-Horned Rhinoceros
View a variety of animals and ride on the back of an elephant at Kaziranga Park
Visit Dirang, which is known for its apple and kiwi farming
Visit to Asia's third-largest Orchidarium in Dirang
Visit Tawang to see Asia’s second-largest Buddhist monastery and Sela Pass and Sela Lake near Tipi
Travel to Nameri National Park, which is a tiger reserve

main.title: 9 Days Meghalaya Assam Arunachal Tour Package Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Guwahati to Shillong
items: Drive to Shillong from Guwahati Airport or Railway Station.
A visit to Nehru Park and a tour of the stunning man-made Umiam Lake.
Check into your hotel in shillong .

days.title: Day 2 : Cherrapunji Sightseeing
items: Start your excursion to Cherrapunji after breakfast.
Visit Elephant Falls and Shillong Peak on your way to Cherrapunji.
The Nohkalikai Falls, Seven Sister Falls, and Wei Sawdong Falls are all breathtaking.
Witness the mysterious Mawsmai Caves and Arwah Caves.
Return to Shillong in the evening for a peaceful night's sleep.

days.title: Day 3 : Shillong Sightseeing
items: Your sightseeing tour in Shillong begins after your excellent breakfast.
Ward's Lake and the Shillong Golf Course are worth seeing in Shillong.
Later, visit Lady Hydari Park and the Don Bosco Museum, which highlights the tribals' native culture.
After that, head into your hotel for a peaceful night's sleep.

days.title: Day 4 : Shillong to Kaziranga
items: Prepare for a trip to another gorgeous state in the Northeast by eating breakfast.
Drive to Kaziranga, home of the world's only one-horned rhinoceros.
The evening is yours to do as you like.
Check into your hotel room.

days.title: Day 5 : Kaziranga National Park and Dirang
items: This day will be loaded with exciting events.
You will be taken on an elephant back safari early in the morning.
You will also get the opportunity to witness Rhinos.
Later in the afternoon, you will have another jeep safari to the western range, where you can see diverse Fauna such as hog deers, rhinos, and sambhars.
After that, travel to Dirang, which is famous for its apple and kiwi plantations.
In Dirang, visit Asia's third-largest Orchidarium.
After a long day, return to your Dirang hotel.

days.title: Day 6 : Dirang to Tawang
items: After your breakfast head to Tawang.
The Sela Pass, on the road to Tawang, is the world's second-highest pass.
The National Yak Research and Breeding Centre, Natural Hot Water Spring, and Jaswantgarh are all along the road.
Check into your hotel when you arrive in Tawang.

days.title: Day 7 : Tawang Sightseeing
items: Start your tour of Tawang after a great breakfast.
Visit the War Memorial and the birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama.
The 300-year-old Tawang Monastery is a must-see.
Later, visit Tawang's second-biggest Buddhist monastery.
Check into your Tawang hotel for a restful night's sleep.

days.title: Day 8 : Tawang to Bhalukpong
items: We'll leave after breakfast towards Bhalukpong.
Bhalukpong is a stunningly gorgeous spot on the border between Assam and Arunachal Pradesh.
The Jia Bhorole River, which passes through Bhalukpong, is a dazzling adventurer's dream.
Travel to the tiger refuge Nameri National Park.
Check into your Bhalukpong hotel.

days.title: Day 9 : Bhalukpong Tour
items: Drive to Nameri National Park in the morning after breakfast.
Observe the White Winged Wood Duck, which is virtually extinct.
The park is home to elephants, leopards, Smbhar, Barking Deer, Wild Boar, Gaur, and a variety of birds, including four species of Hornbill.

days.title: Day 10 : Bhalukpong-Guwahati
items: After breakfast, depart for Guwahati Airport or Railway Station with all of the pleasant recollections of our fantastic vacation.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which is beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7 (seven) business days in the customer's bank account.
